title: Deployment memo and tiered update digest with ops runbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a single, shareable deployment memo and a set of tiered update digests (customer bulletin + internal ops runbook) for the runtime-2.0 rollout. The artifact should support segmented audiences (PLG developers, enterprise Dedicated customers, and Private/VPC customers), include an embargo path, and attach a short ops runbook for on-call and support engineers. Avoid creating multiple competing docs; this ticket consolidates the narrative, translation needs, and signoff flow.
objectives: Produce a one-page deployment memo for executive and partner readouts
Ship a customer-facing tiered update digest (short, medium, long variants) for email, docs, and support KB
Deliver an internal ops runbook with troubleshooting steps, rollback criteria, and monitoring links
Establish an approval sequence and embargo lift schedule tied to the release gate
scope: All copy and attachable artifacts for the update digest (EN, and skeletons for i18n)
Ops runbook including key SLOs, dashboards, and triage playbook
A short FAQ for known customer questions and migration notes
Not in scope: full localized translations (we provide skeletons and handoff to localization team)
target_audiences: PLG developer users (self-serve) - 1-paragraph summary + technical links
Enterprise customers (Dedicated) - migration notes and SLA callouts
Private/VPC customers - upgrade notes, maintenance window expectations
Internal stakeholders - Eng on-call, Solutions, Support, Sales, CSMs
deliverables: Tiered update digest: short (50-100 words), medium (200-400 words), long (detailed changelog)
Ops runbook (markdown) with runbook checklist and rollback steps
FAQ and embeddable snippets for docs and support KB
Signoff checklist and embargo schedule document
